name: shahnameh-crown-of-ashes
description: Ferdowsi's Shahnameh: Crown of Ashes & Light — Mature 2D Persian Miniature Action-RPG

scripts.build:win-exe: vite build --base=./ && npx electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.build:linux: vite build --base=./ && npx electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.build:mac: vite build --base=./ && npx electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.build:android-apk: vite build --base=./ && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
